events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: On this day in '68, The Beatles gave us the iconic 'White Album'. A double LP that pushed boundaries and still sounds fresh. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Remembering Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Showman
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his presence, his legacy continue to rock the world. Forever a champion.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Masterpiece
angles.copy: A true game-changer! On this day in '65, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that blended folk and rock and changed everything.

events.title: Tribute to John Lennon
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His message of peace and his timeless music resonate as strongly as ever. Imagine.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable. Forever missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King Lives On
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his music still moves generations. Thank you, thank you very much.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist, songwriter, and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro of the riff, Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his guitar work is pure legend.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Timeless Rocker
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking, still soulful, still making us sing along.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th to Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing ska-pop joy and a touch of Camden cool for decades. Have a good one!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The smooth-voiced English singer Paul Young, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul Star
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got us 'Wherever I Lay My Hat'. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon, singer, songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true living legend, still shining bright like a diamond.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the incredible Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to solo hits, his songwriting legacy is huge.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British R&B and pop sensation Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars, his hits are pure sunshine.

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction
events.blurb: The first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 23, 1986, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in '86, rock history was made with the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction! Who was your must-have for that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming audiences after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Legendary Last Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. The ultimate impromptu gig!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The acclaimed English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, his hits are simply 'In The Air Tonight'.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo chart-topper, he keeps bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved English actor Sir David Jason, known for roles like Del Boy and Inspector Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to a true national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Peckham to Pop Larkin, his characters are etched in our hearts. Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died' on February 3, 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Tragedy
angles.copy: On this day in 1959, music lost three stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'.
